title: Spot the Accessibility Leak
blurb: A member can't be more accessible than the types it exposes. These snippets won't compile — find the declaration that leaks a less-accessible type, and pick the fix.

levels.title: L1 · The exposed return type
levels.prompt: One line here causes a CS0050 'inconsistent accessibility' error. Which declaration, and how do you fix it?

payload.intro: All four declarations live in the same public class.

failStates.title: internal on its own is fine
failStates.explain: OrderDto being internal isn't the problem — plenty of types are internal. The error is the PUBLIC member that hands that internal type out. Look at GetOrder.

failStates.title: string is public
failStates.explain: A public property of type string is perfectly consistent — string is public. The leak is a public member exposing an internal type.

failStates.title: InternalsVisibleTo is a different tool
failStates.explain: InternalsVisibleTo opens internals to a specific OTHER assembly (e.g. tests). It doesn't fix an inconsistent-accessibility error within this assembly. The return type must be at least as accessible as the method — make OrderDto public (or make the method internal).

failStates.title: It genuinely won't compile
failStates.explain: A public method can't return an internal type: CS0050, 'return type is less accessible than method'. The compiler rejects it.

levels.title: L2 · The exposed base class
levels.prompt: Another accessibility mismatch — this time about inheritance. Find the broken declaration and the fix.

payload.intro: Two types in the same assembly, plus a constructor.

failStates.title: The constructor isn't the leak
failStates.explain: A public constructor is fine. The error is that a PUBLIC class derives from an INTERNAL base — the base type is less accessible than the class exposing it.

failStates.title: The base being internal is only half the story
failStates.explain: internal is a valid choice for a base class. The conflict is created by the public class that derives from it — that's the declaration the compiler flags (CS0060).

failStates.title: That doesn't touch the real problem
failStates.explain: The constructor's accessibility is unrelated. The error is CS0060: a public class can't have an internal base. Make RepositoryBase public (or make UserRepository internal).

failStates.title: It won't compile
failStates.explain: CS0060, 'inconsistent accessibility: base class is less accessible than derived class.' A public class effectively exposes its base, so the base must be at least as accessible.
